interest: Shows 1946 US tracking of Panamanian appointee Humberto Ballestas's ties to Yoshitaro Amano's Japanese espionage network in the Canal Zone.
overview: A July 1946 Embassy despatch reports Panamanian appointee Humberto Ballestas, sent to New Orleans's founding anniversary, was identified by US intelligence as a pre-war associate of Japanese espionage chief Yoshitaro Amano and interned German Walter Kirchner; includes an FBI routing copy and later GSA withdrawal notices.

people.name: Humberto Ballestas
people.role: Representative of the Government of Panama to New Orleans; collector of back taxes; former employee and confidant of Yoshitaro Amano

people.name: Raul R. Acevedo
people.role: Collector of back taxes for the Government of Panama

people.name: Yoshitaro Amano
people.role: Head of Japanese espionage activities in Central and South America

people.name: Walter Kirchner
people.role: German national interned and repatriated to Germany at the outbreak of World War II

people.name: V. Lansing Collins, Jr.
people.role: Second Secretary of Embassy, American Embassy at Panama

subfiles.about: Reports that Humberto Ballestas, an alleged associate of Japanese and German espionage figures, was designated to represent the Panamanian government in New Orleans.
subfiles.summary: Despatch No. 2005: Collins reports Humberto Ballestas, Panama's delegate to New Orleans's anniversary, was a wartime associate of Japanese espionage chief Yoshitaro Amano and German internee Walter Kirchner.
subfiles.title: Despatch No. 2005 from Collins on Humberto Ballestas

subfiles.about: Transmits a copy of Embassy Panama Despatch No. 2005 regarding Humberto Ballestas to the Federal Bureau of Investigation.
subfiles.summary: State Department forwards Despatch No. 2005 on Humberto Ballestas's wartime Axis ties to the FBI.
subfiles.title: Department of State Transmittal of Despatch No. 2005 to FBI
